title: SYM Maxsym TL 508 (Apex Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Vespa SYM Maxsym TL 508 (Apex Spec) is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 50cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
